days.file: Carl Bloch - The Sermon on the Mount.jpg
days.title: The Sermon on the Mount
days.alt: Seated on a rock above a crowd, Jesus lifts one hand as he teaches, while listeners in robes and headscarves look up at him.
days.look: Look again at Jesus’ raised hand and the faces turned toward him. What worry would you let him answer today?
days.license: Artist died 1890; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Annunciation
days.alt: Mary sits with her arms crossed over her chest and an open book on her knee, as a rose-robed angel bows before her.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s folded arms. What would it cost you to say yes without seeing the way?
days.license: Artist died 1455; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Joseph the Carpenter
days.alt: Bent over his work by candlelight, Joseph drills while the boy Jesus holds the candle and looks up at him.
days.look: Look again at the boy holding the candle for Joseph’s work. Where could you offer your own work, even if it is small?
days.license: Artist died 1652; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Quinten Massijs (I) - The Moneylender and his Wife - WGA14281.jpg
days.title: The Moneylender and His Wife
days.alt: A man weighs coins on a table covered with gold and pearls while his wife turns the pages of a prayer book beside him.
days.look: Look again at the hands sorting the coins one by one. Are you ready to look at your own numbers, with God beside you?
days.license: Artist died 1530; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Simeon in the temple, by Rembrandt van Rijn.jpg
days.title: Simeon’s Song of Praise
days.alt: In a dim temple, the old man Simeon holds the swaddled Christ child in a pool of light, with Mary and Joseph beside him.
days.look: Look again at the light falling on the old man and the child. What are you still waiting for God to show you?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Holy Family with a Little Bird
days.alt: Joseph holds the toddler Jesus on his lap while Mary winds wool beside them and a small dog looks up.
days.look: Look again at Joseph’s hands steadying the child. What would help your home to be gentler tonight?
days.license: Artist died 1682; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Saint Paul in Prison
days.alt: The aged Paul sits in a stone cell, one hand at his chin and the other on a book, in a shaft of light from a high window.
days.look: Look again at Paul in his cell, in the light from the window. What would you say to God about today’s deadlines, by name?
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: (Venice) The parable of the Good Samaritan by Domenico Fetti - Gallerie Accademia.jpg
days.title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
days.alt: The Samaritan lifts the wounded traveler onto his donkey, holding him close under a windswept tree.
days.look: Look again at the Samaritan’s arms around the stranger. Who is the neighbor you owe love to today?
days.license: Artist died 1623; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: CodexAureus Cleansing of the ten lepers.jpg
days.title: The Cleansing of the Ten Lepers, from the Codex Aureus of Echternach
days.alt: In a medieval illumination, Christ in a green cloak raises his hand over a man in red who has bowed to the ground at his feet.
days.look: Look again at the one man bowed to the ground at Christ’s feet. What one thing can you thank God for today?
days.license: Manuscript made c. 1035–1040; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
